evidence.detail: StreamLoader invokes rs/x/a.a(output, outputLength, input, compressedLength, inputOffset) when an archive or archive entry requires BZip2 decompression.
The public entry point populates one shared rs/x/b state object with input/output buffers, offsets and counters, runs the private bit/Huffman/BWT decode pipeline and returns produced byte count.
Private methods implement the characteristic BZip2 bit reader, selector/Huffman tables, move-to-front decoding and block reconstruction against rs/x/b scratch arrays.

proposals.note: BZip2Decompressor is fixed by StreamLoader call sites and the exact BZip2 bit/Huffman/BWT decode pipeline.

evidence.detail: rs/x/f constructs a Stream over archive bytes, reads packed/unpacked lengths, optionally decompresses the whole archive, then reads file count and per-entry hash/size/offset tables.
File extraction uppercases the requested name and computes the classic rolling hash value*61 + char-32 before matching the stored entry hash.
For non-whole-archive compression it invokes BZip2Decompressor on the selected entry; otherwise it copies bytes directly from the decompressed archive payload.
R55 IndexedImage/TextDrawingArea and numerous R28 definitions receive rs/x/f as their archive/resource source and request named payloads from it.

proposals.note: StreamLoader preserves the classic archive/resource-loader identity: hashed named entries plus whole/per-entry decompression.

evidence.detail: rs/x/b is instantiated once by BZip2Decompressor and is passed through all private decode stages; no unrelated subsystem owns or consumes it.
The class contains input/output byte arrays, bit-buffer counters, in-use flags, selector arrays, frequency/cumulative tables, Huffman limit/base/perm tables and block reconstruction scratch state.
All fields are mutable package-private decoder state updated in-place by rs/x/a during one decompression operation.

proposals.note: BZip2DecompressionState is the dedicated mutable decoder-state object consumed only by BZip2Decompressor.

evidence.detail: rs/x/e owns a byte[] payload and mutable offset plus bit-position/checksum-style state, and exposes the broad primitive read/write surface used throughout config, archive and packet decoding.
Methods cover byte/short/int/long variants, signed/unsigned forms, strings, bulk byte transfers, smart/variable-length values, bit access and cryptographic/RSA-style transforms.
StreamLoader, definitions, animation/image loaders and client networking construct this class directly over byte arrays and advance its public offset field while decoding structured data.

proposals.note: Stream is the conservative classic-client name for the byte-buffer/offset primitive codec used across archives, configs and networking.
